page_title: ATA 5-0 FRO | Atalanta v Frosinone 15/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.

90+3' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Stefano Turati, who pulls off a stunning save! Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' 5 - 0 Emil Holm (Atalanta) scores with a header from inside the box after a goalmouth scramble.
90' Atalanta earn a corner.
90' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) fails to turn the rebound in as the goalkeeper pulls off a great save to keep him out. Atalanta will take a corner kick.
89' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

89' He should have scored! Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Atalanta force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
88' Atalanta are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
86' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
84' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Matias Soule.

83' 4 - 0 It's a goal! Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Mario Pasalic. The score is now 4:0.

81' Fares Ghedjemis (Frosinone) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Marco Carnesecchi shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
81' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Ederson is replaced by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).
79' Luis Muriel picks out Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta), who drives a shot just wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
76' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
75' Here comes a substitution. Mehdi Bourabia (Frosinone) is brought on as a substitute for Luca Mazzitelli.
75' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alessandro Prontera blows for a foul. Frosinone are awarded a free kick.

73' Stefano Turati doesn't have to worry about this one. Aleksey Miranchuk plays a pass into the feet of Emil Holm (Atalanta), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the right post.
71' Luis Muriel (Atalanta) takes just a short run up and his weak long-range free kick is blocked by the defensive wall.
70' Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
69' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atalanta comes to nothing.
68' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
68' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta).

66' The most active player in today's match is definitely Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
64' This should have been a goal! Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) sends a killer pass into the box, but Luis Muriel can't trick the opposition's defence and loses possession.
63' The substitution is prepared. Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Charles De Ketelaere.
62' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Luis Muriel (Atalanta) replacing Gianluca Scamacca.
61' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Alessandro Prontera who sees an offensive foul.
58' Matias Soule (Frosinone) with a wonderful solo effort. He blasted from long range, but the shot towards the bottom right corner was thwarted by Marco Carnesecchi.
56' A pass from Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) is intercepted by Marco Carnesecchi and the move breaks down.
56' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
54' Substitution. Matteo Ruggeri is replaced by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta).
54' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Sead Kolasinac and he is replaced by Isak Hien (Atalanta).
53' Some great controlled play and passing from Frosinone. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
52' Kevin Bonifazi (Frosinone) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alessandro Prontera has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
51' Emil Holm (Atalanta) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
50' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
46' Frosinone take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
46' The game is over for Pol Lirola. Fares Ghedjemis (Frosinone) comes on for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Eusebio Di Francesco decided to make a change. Abdou Harroui is replaced by Francesco Gelli (Frosinone).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Eusebio Di Francesco probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Mateus Lusuardi. He is replaced by Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone).
46' The whistle blows and Alessandro Prontera starts the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the right post.
45+3' Matias Soule (Frosinone) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Half-chance! Emil Holm (Atalanta) plays a pass into the box, but Stefano Turati reacts well to snuff out the attack.
43' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
42' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Frosinone for a penalty. Play continues.
41' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.

40' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Marco Carnesecchi is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
39' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
37' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
35' Pol Lirola (Frosinone) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
34' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) commits a rough challenge and Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle for an infringement.
33' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
32' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
32' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
30' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) is penalised for a foul. Alessandro Prontera had a clear view and blows his whistle.
29' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:0.
27' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) and Abdou Harroui attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
25' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) takes the corner which is cleared.
25' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the right post. His effort, however, is blocked by Stefano Turati, who pulls off a stunning save!
24' Ederson (Atalanta) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball into the middle of the goal, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.
23' The ball is cleared after Matias Soule (Frosinone) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
22' The foul by Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) was seen by Alessandro Prontera who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
20' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort well wide of the left post.
18' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
17' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

17' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atalanta.

14' 3 - 0 Fabulous goal. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) collects an exquisite pass and subsequently produces a snap shot from the edge of the box which goes in off the upside of the left post and inside the back of the net.
13' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Matteo Ruggeri plays it into the box, and Ederson (Atalanta) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 2:0.
11' The resulting corner, taken by Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta), comes to nothing.
11' An attempted cross from Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) is cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Atalanta will have a corner.
10' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
9' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
8' 1 - 0 Goal! Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Stefano Turati into the bottom left corner.
7' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

6' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Mateus Lusuardi (Frosinone). Alessandro Prontera saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. PENALTY! One of the players from Atalanta is about to take a penalty kick.
5' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) plays a one-two with Gianluca Scamacca, but the move breaks down.
3' Atalanta are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
2' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
1' Matias Soule (Frosinone) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Frosinone force their opponents to concede a corner.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Atalanta will take the kick-off.
Alessandro Prontera got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
